title: Air-Gapped Field Triage
description: Laptop-scale, zero-egress guidance for on-scene triage. Same core as MinimalForensics, with explicit advice to keep graphs small, hash at acquisition, and stay offline.
mission: Help a field examiner produce hash-verified CASE graphs with no network and without loading the CAC T-Box.

File.notes: Hash every file at acquisition. Prefer one focused graph per volume, device, or app when the seizure is large.

recipe_skeleton.summary: One focused graph per device or volume; hash everything; never call the network.
steps: Create one Investigation graph per volume, app, or device when the seizure is large — not one unbounded graph.
Record Tool + InvestigativeAction for the triage collector.
Emit File/Device/RasterPicture observables with the required Facet sets.
Stay inside the published PERFORMANCE_GUIDE comfort zone for laptop RAM.
Write JSON-LD locally; validate offline with case-utils.
